segments.title: Flamingos SLEEP on one leg
segments.say: Flamingos can sleep standing on one leg.

segments.title: Almost NO muscle needed
segments.say: And it takes almost no muscle effort.

segments.title: They sway LESS asleep
segments.say: When they doze off, they sway even less. People sway more.

segments.title: That bend? It's the ANKLE
segments.sub: The knee is hidden **in the feathers**
segments.say: And that backwards knee? It's actually the ankle.

segments.title: Measured at Zoo Atlanta
segments.say: Scientists from Georgia Tech and Emory measured it at Zoo Atlanta.
Follow for Weird Animal number 24 tonight.
